courses.title: Data Structures
courses.syllabus: Core data structures and their analysis: arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, heaps, hash tables and graphs.

courses.title: Algorithms & Complexity
courses.syllabus: Design and analysis of algorithms: divide and conquer, greedy methods, dynamic programming and NP-completeness.

courses.title: Intro to Programming
courses.syllabus: A first course in programming with Python: variables, control flow, functions, lists and dictionaries.

courses.title: Graduate Seminar: ML Systems
courses.syllabus: Graduate seminar on building and operating machine learning systems in production.

courses.title: Linear Algebra
courses.syllabus: Systems of linear equations, matrices, vector spaces, eigenvalues and orthogonality.

courses.title: Computer Architecture
courses.syllabus: How computers work: digital logic, datapath design, pipelining and the memory hierarchy.

courses.title: Technical Writing
courses.syllabus: Clear and persuasive technical writing: memos, proposals, style guides and visual design.

courses.title: Operating Systems
courses.syllabus: Processes, threads, scheduling, memory management and file systems.

courses.title: Probability
courses.syllabus: Probability spaces, random variables, distributions and limit theorems.

courses.title: Physics I
courses.syllabus: Mechanics: motion, forces, energy and momentum with laboratory work.

courses.title: Machine Learning
courses.syllabus: Supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation and neural networks.
